tieu_de: Senior AI Native Engineer Python, SQL, LLM, AWS
dia_chi_raw: Phòng L5-20, Tầng 5, Số 343, đường Hoàng Sa, Phường Tân Định
mo_ta_cong_viec:
What This Role Is
We are building AI-native delivery systems without a fixed precedent. AI-augmented engineering and agentic workflows are shifting the core constraint from building software to designing, orchestrating, and improving intelligent systems that can reason and act.
As a Senior AI Native Engineer, you will own end-to-end AI product surfaces—from ideation to production—working across product, engineering, and applied AI systems to turn ambiguity into working, scalable solutions.
You will work closely with internal stakeholders on rapid experimentation, prototyping, and Lab based initiatives that demonstrate and validate new agentic capabilities.
From a technical standpoint, you should be able to engage meaningfully with product teams and understand core system design concepts. This includes having a realistic understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, recognizing why certain problems are more complex than they appear, and understanding how system performance and success are evaluated in production environments. While implementation sits with engineering, you are responsible for the correctness of what gets built. That means reviewing technicalproposals, interrogating assumptions, and ensuring that every solution is feasible, well-structured, and grounded in real system behavior with the engineering and delivery team. Concretely, you are responsible for four things:
End-to-End AI System Ownership
Lead the end-to-end design and development of AI-native products, including agents, workflows, and intelligent systems built on modern cloud architectures
Own and implement AI-driven pipelines and workflows, ensuring reliability, scalability, reusability, and production readiness
Design system architectures for AI applications, including agent frameworks, RAG pipelines, and multi-step reasoning workflows
Collaborate closely with engineers, data scientists, and stakeholders to deliver AI-powered features, decision systems, and automation solutions.
Oversee integration of structured and unstructured data sources, ensuring strong governance, reliability, and system integrity
Establish best practices around code quality, testing, documentation, and CI/CD for AI systems and workflows
Contribute to development of AI agents and intelligent services leveraging real-time data, APIs, and vector-based retrieval systems
Optimize system performance, latency, cost, and scalability across AI pipelines and infrastructure layers
Work directly with global stakeholders, gathering requirements and translating them into scalable AI product solutions
Mentor junior builders and contribute to a strong engineering and AI product culture
yeu_cau:
What We Are Looking For
5+ years of experience in software engineering, AI product development, or data-driven system engineering
Demonstrated experience designing and delivering production AI systems, including agents, automation pipelines, or intelligent workflows
Strong foundation in AI system architecture, including LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and workflow orchestration
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL for developing reliable, scalable AI-enabled systems
Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) in production environments
Experience integrating APIs and building service-oriented or event-driven architectures
Strong knowledge of data engineering concepts, including handling structured and unstructured data at scale
Excellent communication skills in English, capable of working with different teams and senior stakeholders
Proven leadership ability with strong problem-solving skills and full lifecycle ownership of technical initiatives
You Will Work Across
This role spans multiple domains depending on product needs:
AI agents and multi-step autonomous workflows
RAG systems over messy, real-world data (e.g., planning documents, regulations, reports)
Decision intelligence systems and spatial AI applications for real estate and operational use cases
Full-stack product development with engineering and delivery team (frontend interaction design, backend systems, and API integration)
Rapid prototyping of new ideas, tools, and internal systems
Any component required to move the product forward in each given cycle.
There is no existing product function to inherit and no backlog to pick up from. We are looking for someone who wants to build something from scratch —and who understands that in this team, building means
actually building
